_note: Weights on the three previous seasons' minutes (current season = 1) and a multiplier on the shrinkage constant. Chosen in two stages on an in-season backtest (validation/tw_opt2.py; 8 seasons x 5 checkpoints, predicting each player's rest-of-season Impact per 60): season weights by correlation (monotone: last >= two ago >= three ago), then shrinkage by error so estimate levels are calibrated (slope ~1). Validation numbers are leave-one-season-out vs. the previous scheme (this season + last at half weight; goalies a quarter). Extra weight on the most recent games: no gain (F +.0006, D and G worse), not used.
prior_model_note: Experience-based prior (per 60): players with little previous NHL ice time are pulled toward a below-average level, veterans toward average: prior = a + b*ln(1 + weighted previous minutes/1000). Chosen to improve both the survivor-free team test (roster r .561 -> .586) and the player test (F r .630 -> .632, RMSE .351 -> .349; D neutral). An age term was tested in the prior and hurt the player test; not used. Goalies keep the plain newcomer prior.
